enchantment.iguanatweaksreborn.smite.des: Aumenta i danni contro i non-morti
Aumenta la possibilità e il danno dei colpi critici

iguanatweaksreborn.milk_cooldown: Il fluido di %s non è ancora pronto
iguanatweaksreborn.no_damage_item: Questo oggetto non è affilato, colpisce come un pugno
iguanatweaksreborn.no_efficiency_item: Questo oggetto è vecchio e arrugginito, non può rompere nessun blocco
iguanatweaksreborn.broken_item: This item is broken, must be repaired

iguanatweaksreborn.loose_bed_respawn_poi: Your respawn point is loose, you'll respawn in a radius from your bed.
iguanatweaksreborn.requires_catalyst: Can't activate. The Obelisk requires at least one catalyst block
iguanatweaksreborn.obelisk_disabled: Respawn Obelisk disabled. Your respawn point has been set to your last bed, or reset if you didn't have one
iguanatweaksreborn.fail_respawn_obelisk: You couldn't respawn at the obelisk because it was disabled.
iguanatweaksreborn.set_old_respawn: Your old respawn point has been set. If your Obelisk runs out you'll respawn here.
iguanatweaksreborn.sneak_to_overwrite: You can overwrite an Obelisk respawn point by sneak-right-click.
iguanatweaksreborn.decorative_beds: Beds are just a nice decoration. No sleep allowed
iguanatweaksreborn.no_spawn_point: You cannot set a respawn point. Better leave a trace from the world's spawn.
iguanatweaksreborn.enjoy_the_night: Your respawn point has been set. Enjoy the night!
effect.iguanatweaksreborn.tired.descript: Obtained when haven't slept in a while. Reduces movement speed and sight.
iguanatweaksreborn.not_tired: You're not tired enough to sleep
iguanatweaksreborn.too_tired: You should really get some sleep
iguanatweaksreborn.no_food_for_sleep: You're too hungry and can't fall asleep

emi.info.iguanatweaksreborn.items.name_t: When applied to a named entity will drop the previous name tag. If the item is not renamed will remove the name from the entity.
emi.info.iguanatweaksreborn.crops.seeds: Can be found in the wild
emi.info.iguanatweaksreborn.golden_power: Fastest speed powered rail, should not be used for slopes due to Minecarts being wonky
gamerule.iguanatweaks:deathLoseItemsEnch: Enchanted items are lost on death
If Percentage items lost on death is above 0, enchanted items can be lost on death

Completely disables Experience, from mob drops to the xp bar

advancements.iso.wooden_pickaxe.title: Photosynthesis
advancements.iso.wooden_pickaxe.descript: Obtain your first Wooden Tool. Lasts a lot under the sunlight.
advancements.iso.seeds.title: Seedy Business
advancements.iso.winter_is_coming.title: Winter is coming
advancements.iso.winter_is_coming.descri: It's autumn! Make sure to stack up food and wood before Winter as almost nothing grows and animals don't spawn. A calendar can help you keep track of the season.
advancements.iso.iron_nugget.title: Small traces in stone
advancements.iso.iron_nugget.description: Obtain an Iron Nugget by mining Stone
advancements.iso.cloth.title: Give me your dress
advancements.iso.bundle.title: That one item
advancements.iso.chainmail.title: Forged from fire
advancements.iso.chainmail.description: Obtain a Chainmail piece of armor
advancements.iso.campfire.title: Early Game Furnace
advancements.iso.torch.title: Shed some light
advancements.iso.torch.description: Obtain a torch, the campfire and some sticks might come in handy
advancements.iso.toolbelt.title: Steve the builder
advancements.iso.toolbelt.description: Obtain a tool belt. Place items in it by right click, equip it with 'V' and open the wheel with 'R' (Keybinds may vary)
advancements.iso.toolbelt_upgrade.title: More slots for the belt
advancements.iso.toolbelt_upgrade.descri: Obtain a belt pouch and use an anvil to upgrade your Tool Belt
advancements.iso.furnace.title: A primitive smelter
advancements.iso.furnace.description: Obtain a Furnace, the campfire might help smelting the Copper
advancements.iso.rich_farmland.title: Better use for Bone Meal
advancements.iso.rich_farmland.descripti: Use Bone Meal on Farmland (or on crops while crouching) to create Rich Farmland. Rich farmland makes crops grow faster, but decays after a while.
advancements.iso.anvil_fix.title: Fix the fixer
advancements.iso.anvil_fix.description: Repair an anvil with Iron Blocks.
advancements.iso.golden_pickaxe.title: Lucky Gold
advancements.iso.golden_pickaxe.descript: Obtain a Gold Pickaxe by upgrading a Flint Pickaxe. You'll feel luck run through your veins.
advancements.iso.respawn_obelisk.title: The ancients respawned here
advancements.iso.activate_respawn_obelis: Activate a Respawn Obelisk with right-click by placing at least a precious block at the same height and set the respawn point. Respawning here will give some buffs, other than a precise respawn.
advancements.iso.firestarter.title: Starting Fires
advancements.iso.firestarter.description: Craft a Firestarter to create fire more consistently.
advancements.iso.charcoal.title: Improvise and Ignite
advancements.iso.charcoal.description: Coal can only be obtained with an Iron pickaxe or higher. Obtain Charcoal by burning logs. A flint in both hands seems to do the job.
advancements.iso.unfair_oneshot.title: Critical success on constitution
advancements.iso.unfair_oneshot.descript: If you get hit for enough damage that would kill you when your health is above 7.5 hearts, that's an unfair one-shot and you're left with half a heart
advancements.iso.hellish_coal.title: Hot Coal
advancements.iso.biometer.title: Different Ecosystems
advancements.iso.biometer.description: Since some ores are more abundant in certain biomes, the Biometer will help you track in which biome you are in.
advancements.iso.ores.coal.title: From plants to fuel
advancements.iso.ores.coal.description: Great amounts of Coal can be found in Desert
advancements.iso.ores.iron.title: Forged in Fire
advancements.iso.ores.iron.description: Great amounts of Iron can be found in Taigas and Lush Caves
advancements.iso.ores.gold.title: Molten Treasure
advancements.iso.ores.gold.description: Great amounts of Iron can be found in Badlands
advancements.iso.ores.diamond.title: Crystals Under Pressure
advancements.iso.ores.diamond.descriptio: Great amounts of Diamonds can be found in Jungles
advancements.iso.ores.emerald.title: Gems of Tectonic Uplift
advancements.iso.ores.emerald.descriptio: Great amounts of Emeralds can be found in Mountains
advancements.iso.ores.lapis.title: Metamorphic Blue
advancements.iso.ores.lapis.description: Great amounts of Lapislazuli can be found in non-snowy Plains
advancements.iso.ores.redstone.title: Crimson Currents
advancements.iso.ores.redstone.descripti: Great amounts of Redstone can be found in Oceans
advancements.iso.ores.copper.title: Born from Oxidation
advancements.iso.ores.copper.description: Great amounts of Copper can be found in Savanas
